name: Lemon & Herb Chicken Traybake
method: Toss the chicken breasts, halved baby potatoes, chunky courgette, peppers and onion wedges with the oil, mixed herbs, the zest of the lemon and seasoning.
Roast on a large tray at 200°C for 35–40 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are golden.
Squeeze the lemon over before serving.
